# Likeness baseline and rebase

## Establish authority and the real baseline

Read [status](../../../docs/STATUS.md), the current spine and Queue focus via
the [planning agreement](../../../docs/plans/README.md), the
[likeness runbook](../../../docs/art/likeness.md), the
[original-photo flow](../../../docs/art/original-photos.md) and
[launcher help](../../../bin/help.cmd). Identify the exact task, allowed root,
profile, policy, run/code/input bindings and human/publication gates. Verify
existing process and receipt state; do not start a second writer.

Distinguish a verified cleaned raw starting population from a processed
installed Working tree and from frozen Source. If the recipient already has
the correct cleaned raw baseline, verify paths and hashes and do not repeat
historical cleanup. A frozen replay needs its specific Source manifest hash
and preserved prior Working; ordinary baseline refresh has different effects.
Do not reset, refresh Source, modify Production, reuse an old cleanup plan or
copy an entire library to repository scratch without the matching authority
and baseline checks.

## Preview and review before any install

Use the maintained SIMPLE procedure, not a legacy or experimental controller
unless separately selected and authorized. A FULL/LEAN preview can perform
real preparation and write run-local evidence even when assignments are not
published. Check model availability, free space, source/implementation/policy
hashes, input conservation, collision dispositions, qualified cores, rivals,
holds and human-protected decisions. Keep bound inputs and code frozen.

A full SIMPLE rebase can assess eligible existing cast inputs, but that is
not permission to drain Angels or Sisters Gallery, change thresholds, promote
Review votes or enable experimental merges. Treat lower-scoring-member
reassessment and policy changes as their separately approved contracts.
Scores and rival suggestions are evidence, not proof of identity.

Use the exact reviewed preview and its bound arguments for an authorized
Sandbox apply and check; a draft-policy override is not Production approval.
Preserve failed stages, receipts and prior trees. Never rewrite a receipt to
bless changed code, re-run intake just for a check failure or silently
substitute FULL and disposable recovery guarantees.

For monitoring, supported recovery and installed/browser acceptance use
[long-run acceptance](../long-run-acceptance/SKILL.md). Human identity and
crop review remain distinct from successful apply/check/repeat.
